Większość kreatorów CV online daje gotow: Most online CV builders give you a ready-made template and empty fields. You type in your experience and then send the same document to every job offer. Yet recruiters look for what they asked for in the ad: the job title, software, certificates and duties. If you describe them in different words, it is easy to miss that you have the experience they need.
CV pod ogłoszenie działa odwrotnie. Zacz: A CV tailored to the job ad works the other way round. You start with a specific offer: paste the link or the text of the ad.
